turns.q: Any discount if I add a second smaller item?
turns.replyTail:
If you mean a second smaller rug or Rug & Pad Set, The Fall Sale applies automatically at checkout, with no code needed. The discount varies by design, and it’s the best available offer, so the automatic 10% multi-rug discount won’t stack on top of it.

Rug pads, swatches, corner grippers, and gift cards are excluded from The Fall Sale. If you share the designs and sizes you’re considering, I can help compare the options 🙂
